scenario_summary: Higher interest rates, persistent inflation and weaker economic growth.

positive_sectors.rationale: Higher interest rates may support net interest income and credit spreads for large banks.
Insurers can benefit from higher yields on financial reserves and investment portfolios.
Defensive sectors may attract investors during periods of weaker growth and higher uncertainty.
Companies with strong cash generation may be relatively resilient in risk-off environments.
Export-oriented companies may benefit from currency depreciation associated with weaker domestic growth.

negative_sectors.rationale: Higher interest rates increase financing costs and reduce housing affordability.
Retailers are pressured by tighter credit conditions and weaker consumer demand.
Persistent inflation can pressure margins and reduce household purchasing power.
Slower consumer spending directly affects discretionary purchases and services.
Lower growth expectations may reduce corporate investment and demand for capital equipment.

positive_tickers.rationale: Large incumbent bank with strong balance sheet and ability to benefit from higher interest income.
Credit-focused bank that may benefit from higher rates, although asset quality must be monitored.
Major private bank with exposure to credit spreads and financial intermediation.

negative_tickers.rationale: Higher interest rates pressure mortgage affordability and housing demand.
Real estate developers are sensitive to financing costs and weaker demand.
Consumer discretionary retailers are pressured by tighter credit and weaker spending.

investment_view: Defensive positioning with preference for financial institutions.
